# LINK-EIM — Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Research Laboratory

> A self-hosted link hub for the Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Research Laboratory — one fast, privacy-respecting page that gathers every official lab destination: website, laboratory information, research, and social channels.

## Project Overview
- **Project Name:** LINK-EIM
- **Organization:** Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Research Laboratory, Telkom University
- **Repository:** https://github.com/LABEIM/LINK-EIM
- **Production URL:** https://link.eimlab.org/
- **Documentation:** https://github.com/LABEIM/LINK-EIM#readme
- **Maintainer Contact:** lab@eimlab.org

## Tech Stack & Architecture
- **Framework:** Astro 7, TypeScript strict. The public page is prerendered; CMS admin/API routes are server-rendered.
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 with semantic design tokens (centered neutral card on a white canvas, ink and single AA-safe teal accent from the emblem, drifting binary field, self-hosted Instrument Serif + IBM Plex Sans/Mono).
- **Content:** Keystatic CMS (Cloud storage). Site settings and link groups are YAML in `src/content/`, loaded at build time by `src/data/site.ts`; links may use optional 16:9 images and groups may use a list or horizontal-scroll layout.
- **Interface:** An editable lab logo above the title, a reorderable highlighted-links list (the first renders solid, the rest on a quiet surface), and an editable social links list (built-in platform or custom label, custom SVG path, or uploaded logo) render under the tagline; the share button below the link groups opens a share dialog with a page preview, copy-link and email actions, WhatsApp/X/LinkedIn grouped under "More ways to share", and the native share sheet where supported. Horizontal groups show centered overlay arrows on pointer devices and swipe on touch.
- **Deployment:** Cloudflare Workers (the `link.eimlab.org` cutover from Pages is pending). The build emits `dist/` with the prerendered page and static assets in `dist/client/` plus the Worker bundle and generated config `dist/server/wrangler.json` that serves `/keystatic` and `/api/keystatic/*`.
- **CI/CD:** LABEIM Shared CI/CD v2 (`.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml`) builds the site and deploys the `link-eim` Worker with `cloudflare_mode: 'ssr'`.

## Key Endpoints & Routes
- `/` : Primary link hub / landing page
- `/keystatic` : Keystatic CMS admin (Keystatic Cloud sign-in required; not indexed)
- `/api/keystatic/*` : CMS content API (authenticated; not indexed)
- `/.well-known/security.txt` : RFC 9116 security disclosure
